checks: The properness hypothesis puts all three heights b+a,b,b−a strictly inside (−1,1). The sections have equal length two, equal horizontal center and average height b. Thus their two closed-side fractions are 4/6 and their aggregate centroid is the mark.

The explicitly contained symmetric subset has width 2 and height 2(1−b) on each of three bases. Reflection about the mark puts at least half its total mass in every containing closed halfspace, even when vertical boundary fibers are charged. The explicit cap meets this lower bound with raw mass 6(1−b).
Substitution b=1/2,a=−9/20 gives areas 19/10,1,1/10. The upper fraction is 11/30, below 4/9 by 7/90.

On b∈[2/5,1/2], the absolute tilt is at most 1/5 and 1−b≥1/2. The three fiber derivatives are −10,−2,6. Summing all three and summing the two appropriate pairs gives −6,−12,4 for the total, left and right volumes respectively. The original §4 has precisely this minimizing family and both exact calibrations.
readability: Both closed sides include the middle fiber, so their derivatives need not sum to the total derivative.
